messages:
sarah-sales: MerchantGate (large payments) is asking for a quick POC to replace RivalAPI. They want a compatibility shim + security Q answers + pricing parity. Can we scope? @mike-ps @linus-eng @anita-sec

mike-ps: I can run the POC. They want a demo next Tue. Need example prompts and their current rate limits.

linus-eng: FYI RivalAPI returns top-level "result_text" and fragments streams differently. I can build a small proxy to translate requests/responses and emulate chunking. Will add a test harness to diff outputs.

sarah-sales: Workload to test: invoice summarization, chargeback reasoning, templated reply generation, and embeddings for retrieval. I'll DM sample prompts.

jordan-cs: Pricing options to present: 1) usage + small adapter surcharge, 2) Dedicated reserved pool with lower unit cost, 3) trial credits for POC. Add uplift for CMK/Dedicated.

anita-sec: They require customer-managed keys (BYOK). We support CMK for Private/Dedicated but not default hosted. Need legal and product sign-off for hosted exceptions. Also need audit log export and retention answers.

linus-eng: Prototype proxy plan:
```
POST /rival/v1/complete -> proxy -> /v2/generate
map rival.prompt -> messages[0].content
translate choices[0].text -> result_text
optionally emulate chunk_size param for streaming
```
I'll push branch and initial harness by EOD tomorrow.

mike-ps: I'll get their rate limits and a sample dump of ~20 calls they use in prod. Also confirm if they use streaming.

anita-sec: Blocker: BYOK for hosted. If they insist, recommend Dedicated+CMK. Legal, prepare MSA addendum for CMK.

jordan-cs: I'll prepare pricing scenarios with delta for CMK/dedicated (EOD Fri).

sarah-sales: Actions:
- linus-eng: compat proxy + test harness (2 business days)
- mike-ps: collect Rival rate limits + sample calls (tomorrow)
- anita-sec: initial security answers + gaps (48h)
- jordan-cs: pricing scenarios (EOD Fri)

deploy-bot: branch rw/compat/merchantgate-proxy created by linus-eng.

sarah-sales: I'll schedule the demo after prototype. Drop blockers here.
